headline: Public hearings on driveway width variances, lot frontage and width variances, and a parking decision appeal at 384 Main Street.
summary: The Zoning Board of Adjustment will hold public hearings on four requests: two driveway width variances, a lot frontage and width variance, and an appeal of an administrative decision on on-street parking. The board will also review upcoming agenda items, approve past minutes, and review bylaws.
items: Timothy Dionne, 19 Shattuck Street (Sheet 45 Lot 129): variance to exceed maximum driveway width, 24 feet permitted, 34 feet proposed, for a paved driveway expansion within the front setback. RB Zone, Ward 3.

Lindsey Goodykoontz, 13 Doncaster Drive (Sheet B Lot 1760): variance to exceed maximum driveway width, 24 feet permitted, 34 feet proposed, for a paved driveway expansion within the front setback. R9 Zone, Ward 5.

Suzanne P. Raisanen, Trustee, 9 Lamb Road (Sheet B Lot 241): variances to allow a new lot with substandard frontage, 120 feet required, 35 feet proposed, and to allow a lot with substandard width, 150 feet required, 35 feet proposed. R40 Zone, Ward 9.

Wallace Holohan and Kathleen Feltus, 384 Main Street: appeal of administrative decision regarding on-street parking by a business with an approved site plan located at 382 Main Street. RA Zone, Ward 7.
Review of upcoming agenda to determine proposals of regional impact.
location: 3rd floor auditorium, Nashua City Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH
